principle: Manual qualitative coding is authoritative; automated categories and clusters are analysis aids only.

codes.label: Verification seeking
codes.definition: Seeks measurements, sources, evidence or provenance to verify the recommendation.

codes.label: Uncertainty reduction
codes.definition: Seeks information mainly to reduce uncertainty before deciding.

codes.label: Comparison search
codes.definition: Compares frameworks or asks counterfactual questions.

codes.label: Skeptical challenge
codes.definition: Explicitly questions or disputes the recommendation/explanation.

codes.label: Terminology clarification
codes.definition: Asks what a metric, term or explanation means.

codes.label: Evidence revisiting
codes.definition: Returns to an evidence area previously inspected before deciding.

codes.label: Information sufficiency
codes.definition: Stops because the available information is judged sufficient.

codes.label: Decision revision
codes.definition: New information causes a change, override or rejection of the initial recommendation.

coding_instructions: Code participant behavior and rationale, not the automated classifier label.
Record a coder note for borderline cases.
If two coders are used, adjudicate disagreements using an agreed procedure.
